build_adversarial_training_config: build a JAXline config for adversarial robust training on CIFAR-10 with PGD attacks and WideResNet
run_experiment_step: run a single training step of the adversarial robustness experiment with supervised and extra inputs
evaluate_model_robustness: evaluate model robustness by computing clean and adversarial top-1 accuracy on the test set
create_trades_loss: create a TRADES loss function that combines clean cross-entropy with adversarial KL divergence regularization
build_dataset_pipeline: build a TensorFlow dataset pipeline with configurable batch sizes and supervised-to-extra data ratios
